findings.summary: Whitespace-wrapped canonical URL-safe material bypasses runtime free-form detection after normalization
findings.cause: looksLikeCredentialValue sees the surrounding spaces and misses the generic encoded shape; normalizeLabel and normalizeReason then trim and return the encoded value, while metadata retains and appends the wrapped value.

findings.summary: The public free-form schema accepts whitespace-wrapped encoded material
findings.cause: credentialValueShape uses an anchored generic alphabet pattern, and the label, metadataValue, and terminal reason schemas apply it to the untrimmed input without a canonicalized-value constraint.
